svg.title: Profile 268 full contact map, historical Mesa drawing and hypothetical V2 line-driver retrofit
svg.desc: All 227 V2 P1 contacts and all 44 contacts on each X, Y and Z DB44 drive are visible in this figure. Historical owner-drawn Mesa paths are separate from dotted guessed V2 retrofit paths through TI AM26LV31E devices and named connectors. No V2 wires are installed.
svg.text: PROFILE 268 · OPTIMILL MH50V · COMPLETE CONTACT / ROUTE STUDY
Owner drawing · V2 P1 design inventory · hypothetical TI line-driver retrofit. Historical and proposed circuits are separate.
DOTTED = GUESS · hypothetical retrofit only · no direct V2-to-DB44 wire
Every guessed segment is labelled at both connector/device contacts. OPEN = unestablished. Solid green = owner-drawn historical reference only.
A · HYPOTHETICAL V2 → AM26LV31E → DRIVE PATHS · NOT FITTED
TI AM26LV31E SOIC-16 pin functions; one hypothetical module per axis. Axis/channel assignment and direction polarity are unverified GUESS; electrical suitability is conditional on drive variant.
